ux.lcopyb.runtimeError.blockedTitle: Your AI service blocked this request
ux.lcopyb.runtimeError.blockedBody: Your AI service's content checks stopped this request. Review your request before sending a new message. Changing the bot's level will not lift that check.
ux.lcopyb.runtimeError.recovery: Review the details, then retry or pick another model in {page}.
ux.lcopyb.errorPreview.blocked: Your AI service blocked this request.
ux.lcopyb.engines.chooseCopy: Choose a copy found on this computer…
ux.lcopyb.engines.availabilityNote: Turning an engine on or off restarts it and stops its replies in progress. Sometimes other engines restart too. Turning one on may run it once to check it works. Work that stopped earlier does not start again by itself.
ux.lcopyb.engines.commandLinesSubtitle: Use Choose location to point an engine at a specific copy of its app, such as a particular version or a wrapper. Give its full location. Saving restarts that engine and stops its replies in progress. Sometimes other engines restart too.
ux.lcopyb.engines.noneFound: No AI apps found on this computer yet.
ux.lcopyb.engines.sameApp: Uses the same app; this account is kept separately.
ux.lcopyb.level.unlimitedHere: Runs everything without asking, except reading your keys and passwords and commands Murage recognizes as able to wipe your computer, which ask first. That includes this computer. Work started by another app's trigger link still asks. Routines use this level unless a routine has its own.
ux.lcopyb.level.unlimited: Runs everything without asking, except reading your keys and passwords and commands Murage recognizes as able to wipe your computer, which ask first. Work started by another app's trigger link still asks. Routines use this level unless a routine has its own.
ux.lcopyb.level.fullHere: Keeps going without asking, including on this computer and before contacting other bots, but stops before deleting outside its folder, paying, messaging someone new, or reading your keys. Work started by another app's trigger link still asks. Routines use this level unless a routine has its own.
ux.lcopyb.level.full: Keeps going without asking, including before contacting other bots, but stops before deleting outside its folder, paying, messaging someone new, or reading your keys. Work started by another app's trigger link still asks. Routines use this level unless a routine has its own.
ux.lcopyb.level.channelHint: On unless you turn it off. Group chats, other people and trigger links from other apps still ask. Routines use their own level.
ux.lcopyb.level.peerSkip: On, but {level} skips this in conversations you start and in routines at that level; work started by another app's trigger link still stops and asks. Switch to Auto to be asked every time.
ux.lcopyb.fullAccess.stillAsks: Work started by another app's trigger link still asks, as it does in Auto.
ux.lcopyb.houseRules.untrusted: A message from a channel, another app's trigger link or a web page can't approve anything or give a bot more access. Full access approves on its own, so give it only to bots you trust with that.
ux.lcopyb.cloud.claudeSignin: Cloud chats use a long-lasting Claude sign-in. Your local connected tools work as before; claude.ai connectors and Remote Control are desktop features and are not part of Cloud chats.
ux.lcopyb.connected.subtitleDesktop: One Flux Router key connects {apps}. You can add your own connected tools too.
ux.lcopyb.connected.subtitleRemote: View your connected apps. Manage them and your connected tools in the desktop app.
